svg.title: Comparison to the desired coarse link V adds exactly its wire discrepancy with coefficient one. The constant is uniform in period and forest on the room domain. The room hypotheses supply its size assumptions, so the same constant is available in the local driving inequality. The source lift retains that exact forest slice, macro gauge and wrapping hypothesis, so the shell estimate used by local driving has the same domain and coefficient; it is not inferred from separate local gauges at the walk endpoints. Explicitly, let D be this forest-slice room domain and let f(U, V ) be the left-hand discrepancy, with the replica interpretation when both parents agree. The recovered scalar is ef = f ◦π on π−1(D), and the port and wire budgets are pulled back by the same map.
